scope: DGAF repository-local recurring assurance families; bounded partial catalog

known_gaps: Many current workflows, assurance scripts, governance tests, security checks, documentation audits, and historical audit families still require classification and mapping.

Current protected-main readback identifies PPTL CI, Governance CI, and PR Issue-State Keyword Guard as required contexts, and all three now have exact workflow-path catalog mappings; exact job/ruleset administration semantics and broader protected-branch configuration remain incomplete for the catalog.
Shared-dependency and independence analysis remains incomplete across the wider assurance surface; some cataloged families intentionally reuse repository-local validators.
External-runtime ingress assurance on current main still requires dedicated catalog expansion and runtime evidence binding.
Historical dated audit reports still require family-versus-execution-instance classification.

audits.name: Governance CI
audits.assertion: Repository governance contracts and their declared verifier paths remain internally consistent for the exact candidate under test.
audits.decision_effect: May block acceptance of a repository candidate when the governance workflow fails within its declared scope.
non_effects: Does not establish scientific efficacy.
Does not by itself establish runtime deployment identity.
Does not grant experimental or High-Assurance authorization.
known_gaps: Workflow success is not independent external verification; exact requiredness depends on protected-branch/ruleset authority.

audits.name: PDMAL Pre-Freeze Runner Validation
audits.assertion: Pre-freeze runner and associated experiment-governance contracts satisfy their repository-defined structural and fail-closed checks.
audits.decision_effect: May block repository acceptance for candidates covered by the pre-freeze validation workflow.
non_effects: Does not itself establish freeze.
Does not authorize collection, materialization, unblinding, or primary analysis.
Does not increment scientific N.
known_gaps: Passing structural validation is not execution evidence for a scientific transition.

audits.name: Truth Layer Validation
audits.assertion: Current repository projections do not violate the declared truth-layer and control-state consistency contracts exercised by the workflow.
audits.decision_effect: May reject a repository candidate with a detected truth-layer inconsistency in the covered checks.
non_effects: Does not prove every claim in the repository true.
Does not create external corroboration or independent validation.
Does not establish runtime or scientific state beyond the checked projection semantics.
known_gaps: Coverage is bounded by implemented assertions and cannot be treated as exhaustive claim verification.

audits.name: Ecosystem Registry Audit
audits.assertion: The machine-readable ecosystem registry satisfies repository-defined projection, metadata, persona-authority, and claim-boundary invariants.
audits.decision_effect: May block a repository candidate whose ecosystem projection violates the implemented registry invariants.
non_effects: Does not make the ecosystem registry authoritative for project-local source/runtime truth.
Does not establish scientific efficacy or authorization.
known_gaps: Live provider facts remain provider-owned; the audit can only validate the evidence and projection inputs it receives.

audits.name: Exact-Source Live Runtime Verification
audits.assertion: A production runtime observation is bound to the exact deployed source identity and satisfies the declared health/regression/audit readback contract for that deployment event.
audits.decision_effect: May establish or reject exact-source runtime verification for a named deployment event when all required bindings and observations are present.
non_effects: Does not transfer runtime evidence to later source revisions.
Does not establish durable replay authority, scientific efficacy, independent validation, or experimental authorization.
known_gaps: Current source has advanced beyond the last fully reconciled historical runtime; #767 controls warning-contract reconciliation on a future exact-source deployment.

audits.name: PR Issue-State Keyword Guard
audits.assertion: Pull requests targeting main bind the exact PR head and reject dangerous GitHub issue-closing keyword plus issue-reference syntax or malformed governed PR-body input within the workflow's declared scope.

non_effects: Does not itself perform or adjudicate an issue-state transition.
Does not authorize any scientific, governance, or runtime action beyond its PR-body guard scope.
Does not establish scientific efficacy, independent validation, or High-Assurance status.
Does not prove that PR titles, comments, commit messages, or other unscanned surfaces are safe.
known_gaps: Workflow scope is pull-request events targeting main and the pull-request body syntax checked by the current parser; it does not imply equivalent coverage of unrelated GitHub text surfaces.
Protected-main requiredness is a separate repository configuration fact observed through branch metadata; this catalog entry does not create that requiredness.

audits.name: Python Tests & Quality Checks
audits.assertion: The candidate satisfies the workflow's pinned Python matrix, changed-file and repository quality checks, full pytest regression suite, bounded security thresholds, deterministic staging-evidence checks, and integration-suite behavior when an integration suite is present.
audits.owner: DGAF Python quality and security workflow
audits.decision_effect: Provides recurring source-quality, regression, security-threshold, and deterministic staging-evidence assurance for a candidate; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
non_effects: Does not establish scientific efficacy or independent validation.
Does not establish successful deployment or production health.
Does not grant materialization, primary-analysis, runtime, or High-Assurance authorization.
Does not establish a minimum code-coverage percentage.
known_gaps: Coverage threshold is configured as zero, so coverage artifacts are observational rather than a minimum-coverage gate.
Codecov upload is explicitly non-blocking and continue-on-error.
Integration execution is skipped when tests/integration is absent.
The full Bandit report is advisory; the blocking threshold is medium-or-higher severity with medium-or-higher confidence and excludes one exact immutable historical Epoch 001 materializer.
Workflow failure semantics do not imply protected-branch requiredness; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow.

audits.decision_effect: Surfaces Markdown-format defects introduced or modified by a covered pull request; current protected-main required-context readback does not list this workflow as a required merge context.
